description: A creator-first MOE skill system for moving social media content from topic selection to reusable content assets.
author: Ivor-NCUT

experts.name: Creator Topic Selector
experts.description: Turn creator context, audience needs, platform signals, and content goals into prioritized topics.

experts.name: Creator Outline Builder
experts.description: Turn an accepted topic into a shootable and writable content outline with multiple opening options.

experts.name: Creator Scene Designer
experts.description: Translate an outline into scenes, shots, props, actions, and visual information.

experts.name: Creator Shooting Director
experts.description: Guide the creator through capturing complete, usable, and expressive footage.

experts.name: Creator Content Writer
experts.description: Turn topics, outlines, and footage notes into scripts, narration, posts, or publishable articles.

experts.name: Creator Rough Cut Planner
experts.description: Build the first coherent edit from raw footage while preserving the story and identifying missing material.

experts.name: Creator Fine Cut Planner
experts.description: Specify pacing, captions, music, visual packaging, and export requirements after the rough cut is stable.

experts.name: Creator Content Reviewer
experts.description: Review a finished or near-finished content piece and route revisions to the correct production stage.

experts.name: Creator Multiplatform Distributor
experts.description: Adapt one content asset into platform-specific publishing packages without flattening platform differences.

experts.name: Creator Data Organizer
experts.description: Normalize creator-provided screenshots or CSV exports into a comparable, auditable content dataset.

experts.name: Creator Strategy Reviewer
experts.description: Turn normalized performance data into evidence-based content strategy and testable next actions.

experts.name: Creator Asset Distiller
experts.description: Convert completed work and validated lessons into reusable creator assets with provenance and usage limits.
